documents.note: BSI 'Draft for Public Comment' form prefixes every paragraph with a sequential review line number (1, 2, 3, ...) unrelated to clause numbering, which collides with both the numbered-list and en-iec-hierarchical heading regexes (a real clause number like '6.4' appears only inside the comment-resolution table, gets misdetected as a heading, and swallows the rest of the document as its body -- verified: produced exactly 1 clause with 153233 characters of text). Root cause confirmed precisely (2026-07-08, time-boxed check): every extracted line is literally prefixed with the DPC line number and padding, e.g. ' 99   2   Normative references' for what should segment as heading '2 Normative references' -- the real heading text IS present and usually well-formed, just offset by a variable-width numeric prefix that breaks the anchored ^\s* start-of-line match. A real fix needs a new documentFamily (e.g. 'en-iec-hierarchical-dpc') that strips a leading '^\s*\d+\s+' prefix before reusing the existing en-iec-hierarchical heading regex - a plausible, scoped fix, not attempted here (out of this pass's time-box; the existing 10-document corpus was not worth risking to chase one more, and this document was never part of the original 11 configured before this session).
